Put the card on your bag.

items.sentenceEn: I glanced at the clock and saw it was late.
items.sentenceZh: 我瞄了一眼時鐘，發現已經很晚了。

items.sentenceEn: The nurse monitored the baby's temperature.
items.sentenceZh: 護理師監測寶寶的體溫。

items.stemEn: He ____ the ball to his dog in the park.
items.stemZh: 他在公園把球丟給他的狗。

items.stemEn: What is the ____ of this meeting?
items.stemZh: 這次會議的目的是什麼？

items.passageEn: My mother's main objective this month is to finish a new website for her company. Every morning, she checks the agenda, glances at her email, and monitors the team's progress on a big screen. She has made an arrangement with her boss to work from home on Fridays. Yesterday, she attached the wrong report to an email by mistake, but she quickly sent the right one. Her team accomplished a lot this week. In the afternoon, her boss gave a short command: "No meetings on Friday!" Then she tossed her pen on the desk and smiled.
items.passageZh: 我媽媽這個月的主要目標是幫公司完成一個新網站。每天早上，她會查看議程、瞄一眼電子郵件，再在大螢幕上監看團隊的進度。她和老闆約定好星期五在家工作。昨天，她不小心在電子郵件裡附錯了報告，不過很快就寄了正確的。她的團隊這週完成了很多事。下午，老闆下了一個簡短的命令：「星期五不開會！」接著她把筆往桌上一丟，笑了。

questions.questionZh: 媽媽這個月的主要目標是什麼？
媽媽和老闆做了什麼安排？

items.promptZh: 她把空瓶子丟進回收桶。
referenceEn: She tossed the empty bottle into the recycling bin.
She tossed the empty bottle in the recycling bin.
rubricZh: toss 表示「扔、拋」，例如 toss something into… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 objective 造一個句子，說說你今年的一個目標。
referenceEn: My objective this year is to read more books.
One objective of mine is to get better at swimming.
rubricZh: objective 表示「目標、目的」，例如 my objective is to… 等說法
說的是自己的目標（例如 my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
